description: This file defines a Java class 'DeleteDatatableCommandHandler' which handles commands to delete datatables in the system. It implements a handler interface, injects a service for datatable operations, and processes delete commands by extracting the datatable name from the URL and invoking the delete method.

classes.name: DeleteDatatableCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for processing commands to delete datatables by name.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to delete a datatable by extracting the datatable name from the URL and invoking the delete operation on the service.
